methods.copy: CPU gathers the batch's unique Host rows into pinned memory; H2D DMA plus native attention in one CUDA graph
methods.direct: Native attention reads mapped Host DRAM for every reference
methods.batch: Batched Host kernel: in-kernel dedup into HBM staging, fetch CTAs overlap PCIe with HBM attention
methods.attn: Memcpy's attention with its H2D removed: the same rows read from HBM, no PCIe (timing only)

timing: GPU events around CUDA graphs of repeated calls; CPU gather for copy reported separately
